SHA256: 319206042390ebfcba934cf0baa2f612f34de463c78c843b7cb8c22097c4bf7b

https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/tree/1.5.1

Submodule libs/hbb_common:
https://github.com/rustdesk/hbb_common/tree/fae47e024dd83cef6aaecde0aa7d11731df11649

An additional source archive is provided alongside GameScreen downloads:
https://github.com/zhouyou0082-lgtm/ops-workbench-updates/blob/main/gamescreen/third-party/rustdesk/1.5.1/rustdesk-1.5.1-corresponding-source.zip
It contains the release source, pinned hbb_common submodule source and reconstruction instructions. Source access is offered without an extra charge.

GameScreen distributes the official executable without modifications and launches it as an independent program. RustDesk is a separate third-party application. It keeps its own permissions, passwords, services and sessions. Closing GameScreen does not close RustDesk sessions.
